name: atlas
description: A per-topic documentation wiki for LLM consumption that keeps itself in sync with the code. Docs declare which files they cover; a PreToolUse(Bash) hook detects drift just before `git push` and can auto-fix the affected docs so the fix rides along in that same push.

interface.shortDescription: Per-topic docs that stay in sync with the code.
interface.longDescription: Maintain a per-topic repository wiki with mechanically detected documentation drift. Repair stale docs in the current host; Claude-backed unattended sync is an optional, separately configured workflow.
defaultPrompt: Check which atlas docs have drifted from the code.
